title: Tesla travels to Europe to persuade Hertz he was wrong

tellings.quote: he was at least from what I've read he actually traveled uh to Europe

plain: A former US Senate staffer, Kurt McConnell, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025 that, from what he has read, the inventor Nikola Tesla travelled to Europe, sometime around the late 1880s or 1890s, to convince the German physicist Heinrich Hertz that Hertz was wrong about how electrical waves work. If true, it would show Tesla held a different theory of electricity than the scientists of his day.
